lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular local maxima are arranged in approximately six vertical columns immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular blobs, creating discrete anchor nodes at the intersection points of vertical and horizontal spot alignments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal structural feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with a high-luminance highlight above and a shadow gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a unique concentric or whorl-like configuration of high-luminance spots near its anterior base, contrasting with the more linear grid patterns observed on the primary torso.
